# Adhunik Powertech Private Limited - Industrial HVAC & Climate Systems

> OEM Manufacturer of Industrial Panel Air Conditioners, Industrial Air Washers, Sensible Cooling Units, and Turnkey Ventilation Systems.

## Core Product Capabilities
- **Industrial Panel Air Conditioners**: Closed-loop IP55 enclosure cooling for CNC, VFD, and automation drive cabinets (250 W to 7,500 W / R134a & R410A).
- **Industrial Air Washers**: Factory evaporative cooling systems (5,000 CFM to 120,000 CFM) with single/two-stage CelDek media and DIDW centrifugal blowers.
- **Sensible Cooling Units (SCU)**: Indirect sensible heat exchangers for hot industrial exhausts and clean spaces.
- **Industrial Blowers**: DIDW forward and backward-curved aerofoil centrifugal fans.

## Primary Regional Corridors Served
- North India: Gurugram, Manesar, Faridabad, Noida, Ghaziabad, Neemrana, Bawal, Sonipat, Haridwar, Roorkee.
- East India: Durgapur, Asansol, Howrah, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, Jharsuguda, Kalinganagar, Rourkela.
- West India: Sanand, Ahmedabad, Morbi, Ankleshwar, Chakan, Aurangabad, Nashik, Kolhapur.
- South India: Sriperumbudur, Coimbatore, Peenya (Bengaluru), Hosur, Hyderabad, Sri City.
